scripts.build:release-macos: npm run build:stable && node desktop/notarize-macos.mjs --zip dist/open-browser-macos-arm64.zip --dmg dist/open-browser-macos-arm64.dmg
scripts.build:release-macos:x64: npm run build:macos:x64 && node desktop/notarize-macos.mjs dist/open-browser-x64.app --zip dist/open-browser-macos-x64.zip --dmg dist/open-browser-macos-x64.dmg
scripts.build:release-macos:arm64: npm run build:macos:arm64 && node desktop/notarize-macos.mjs dist/open-browser.app --zip dist/open-browser-macos-arm64.zip --dmg dist/open-browser-macos-arm64.dmg
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract
scripts.package:macos: npm run build:stable && node desktop/package-macos.mjs --arch arm64 --format both
scripts.package:macos:dmg: npm run build:stable && node desktop/package-macos.mjs --arch arm64 --format dmg
scripts.package:macos:arm64: npm run build:macos:arm64 && node desktop/package-macos.mjs --arch arm64 --format both
scripts.package:macos:x64: npm run build:macos:x64 && node desktop/package-macos.mjs --arch x64 --format both
scripts.package:portable:all: npm run package:windows:x64 && npm run package:linux:x64
scripts.package:all: npm run package:macos && npm run package:portable:all
